Computer Science.description: Prepares students for software engineering, systems, AI/ML, and computing research careers.

coreCourses.name: Systems I: Introduction to Systems Programming

electiveGroups.name: CSE Technical Electives

electiveGroups.name: Math / Statistics Electives

Software Engineering.description: Applies engineering principles to software design, requirements, testing, and project management.

coreCourses.name: Systems I: Introduction to Systems Programming

electiveGroups.name: SFW / CSE Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 12 credit hours from approved CSE/CYB 300â€“500 level courses.

Mechanical Engineering.description: Covers thermodynamics, mechanics, materials, design, manufacturing, fluid mechanics, and controls.

coreCourses.name: Linear Algebra and Differential Equations for Engineers

electiveGroups.name: MME Technical Track Electives
electiveGroups.description: 6 credit hours from approved MME track courses.

Electrical Engineering.description: Covers circuits, signals, electromagnetics, digital systems, power, and embedded computing.

coreCourses.name: Linear Algebra and Differential Equations for Engineers

electiveGroups.name: ECE Technical Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 9 credit hours from 400-level ECE courses.

Finance.description: Covers corporate finance, investments, financial markets, and modeling.

coreCourses.name: Introduction to Computational Thinking for Business
Information Technology and the Intelligent Enterprise
Introduction to Operations and Supply Chain
Financial Principles and Modeling with Excel
Principles of Investments and Security Markets

electiveGroups.name: FIN Upper-Level Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 9 credit hours from approved FIN 300+ courses.

Marketing.description: Develops skills in consumer insights, brand strategy, marketing analytics, and integrated communications.

coreCourses.name: Introduction to Computational Thinking for Business
Information Technology and the Intelligent Enterprise
Introduction to Operations and Supply Chain
Analytical Research and Reasoning for Marketers

electiveGroups.name: MKT Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 10 credit hours from approved MKT/IMS 300+ level courses including one capstone.

Information Systems and Cybersecurity Ma.description: Bridges business strategy and data technology; prepares students for data analytics, IT management, and cybersecurity leadership.

coreCourses.name: Introduction to Computational Thinking for Business
Information Technology and the Intelligent Enterprise
Introduction to Operations and Supply Chain

electiveGroups.name: ISA Concentration Courses
electiveGroups.description: 12 credit hours from your chosen concentration (IS or Cybersecurity Management).

Human Capital Management and Leadership.description: Prepares students for careers in human resources, organizational development, leadership, and talent management.

coreCourses.name: Introduction to Computational Thinking for Business
Information Technology and the Intelligent Enterprise
Introduction to Operations and Supply Chain

electiveGroups.name: HCM Capstone and Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 9 credit hours including one senior capstone experience.

Psychology.description: Covers human behavior, cognitive science, development, clinical, and social psychology with emphasis on research methods.

coreCourses.name: Writing and Research Methods in Psychology

electiveGroups.name: PSY Upper-Level Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 9 credit hours from PSY 300+ courses (at least one at 400 level).

History.description: Prepares students to analyze the past through primary sources, historiography, and research across American, European, and world history.

coreCourses.name: Survey of American History: 1877 to Present

electiveGroups.name: HST Upper-Level Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 18 credit hours in HST at 300 level or above (at least one at 400 level, diversity across regions required).

Political Science.description: Examines political institutions, behavior, theory, comparative politics, and international relations.

electiveGroups.name: POL Advanced Courses (300+)
electiveGroups.description: At least 18 credit hours from POL at 300 level or above, spanning at least two major subfields.

electiveGroups.name: POL Additional 200+ Courses
electiveGroups.description: 6 additional credit hours from POL at 200 level or above.

Sociology.description: Examines social structures, institutions, inequality, and cultural patterns using quantitative and qualitative research methods.

coreCourses.name: Social Relations in the United States

electiveGroups.name: SOC Concentration
electiveGroups.description: 22-23 credit hours from your chosen Sociology or Criminology concentration.

Philosophy.description: Develops critical reasoning and analysis through the study of ethics, logic, metaphysics, epistemology, and political philosophy.

electiveGroups.name: PHL 400/500-Level Seminars
electiveGroups.description: Two seminars totaling 8 credit hours at the 400 or 500 level.

electiveGroups.name: PHL Electives
electiveGroups.description: 12 additional credit hours in philosophy (max one at 100 level, max two at 200 level).

Journalism.description: Develops skills in news writing, reporting, editing, and multimedia storytelling for print, broadcast, and digital platforms.

electiveGroups.name: JRN Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 9 credit hours including at least two JRN courses.

Strategic Communication.description: Prepares students for careers in advertising, public relations, digital media, and corporate communication.

electiveGroups.name: STC Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 9 credit hours from approved STC, JRN, or MJF courses.

Biology.description: Covers cell biology, genetics, ecology, evolution, physiology, and molecular biology with a strong laboratory emphasis.

coreCourses.name: Biological Concepts: Ecology, Evolution, Genetics, and Diversity
Biological Concepts: Structure, Function, Cellular, and Molecular
Physics for the Life Sciences with Lab I

electiveGroups.name: BIO Advanced Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 17 credit hours from BIO 300+ including at least one 400-level, one plant-focused, one animal-focused, and two with labs.

Chemistry.description: Covers inorganic, organic, analytical, and physical chemistry with strong laboratory research training.

electiveGroups.name: CHM Upper-Level Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 9 credit hours from 400-level CHM courses.

Economics.description: Covers microeconomics, macroeconomics, econometrics, and policy analysis with quantitative training.

electiveGroups.name: ECO Field Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 15 credit hours from ECO 300+ (at least 6 from 410+ requiring ECO 315/317).

English - Literature.description: Develops critical reading, analysis, and writing through the study of American, British, and world literatures across historical periods.

coreCourses.name: Introduction to Literary and Cultural Studies
Introduction to Literary and Cultural Theory

electiveGroups.name: ENG Literature Survey Courses
electiveGroups.description: Five literature courses required (no more than two at 100 level).

electiveGroups.name: ENG Advanced Literature
electiveGroups.description: At least 6 credit hours from ENG 440, 450, 480, or 490.

Kinesiology.college: College of Education, Health and Society
Kinesiology.description: Prepares students for careers in exercise science, fitness, wellness, physical therapy, and health promotion.

coreCourses.name: Physics for the Life Sciences with Lab I
Physiology of Exercise and Physical Activity

electiveGroups.name: KNH Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 6 credit hours from approved KNH courses.

Nursing.college: College of Education, Health and Society
Nursing.description: Prepares registered nurses through clinical and didactic instruction in evidence-based practice across the lifespan.

electiveGroups.name: NSG Clinical Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 6 credit hours from approved NSG clinical specialty courses.

Music.description: Provides training in music theory, history, and performance with a focus on musical literacy and artistic expression.

coreCourses.name: Music History I: Antiquity to Baroque
Music History II: Classical to Contemporary
Music Theory IV: Form and Analysis
History of Rock and Popular Music

electiveGroups.name: MUS Performance Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 12 credit hours from applied lessons and ensemble participation.

Art History.description: Critical study of visual art across cultures and historical periods, from ancient to contemporary.

coreCourses.name: Survey of Western Art History I
Survey of Western Art History II

electiveGroups.name: Art History Period/Theme Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 21 credit hours from ART 300â€“400 level art history courses.

Criminal Justice.description: Study of law, crime, policing, courts, and corrections in a sociological and legal context.

electiveGroups.name: CRJ Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 15 credit hours from approved CRJ or SOC 300-level courses.

Environmental Studies.description: Interdisciplinary study of environmental science, sustainability, policy, and ecology.

electiveGroups.name: Environmental Science Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 18 credit hours from science and social science environmental courses.

Social Work.college: College of Education, Health and Society
Social Work.description: Preparation for professional social work practice with individuals, families, and communities.

coreCourses.name: Human Behavior and the Social Environment

electiveGroups.name: SWK Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 12 credit hours from approved SWK electives.

Accounting.description: Prepares students for CPA licensure and careers in public, corporate, or government accounting.

coreCourses.name: Introduction to Computational Thinking for Business
Information Technology and the Intelligent Enterprise
Introduction to Operations and Supply Chain

electiveGroups.name: ACC Professional Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 3 credit hours from approved ACC 200+ courses.

Information Systems & Analytics.description: Combines business analytics, data management, and IT to support organizational decision-making.

electiveGroups.name: ISA Technical Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 12 credit hours from approved ISA or CSE courses.

Management.description: Prepares students for leadership, organizational behavior, HR, and operations management careers.

electiveGroups.name: MGT Major Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 15 credits from approved MGT 300+ courses.

Pre-Medicine.description: Pre-medicine track: complete medical school prerequisites alongside a Biology or Chemistry major.

electiveGroups.name: MCAT Science Electives
electiveGroups.description: Upper-level science courses for MCAT preparation.

Physics.description: Foundational and advanced study of mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, and modern physics.

electiveGroups.name: PHY Upper-Level Electives
electiveGroups.description: At least 9 credit hours from approved PHY 300+ courses.

Pre-Law.description: Pre-law is an advisory track. Students typically major in Political Science, History, or Philosophy while completing recommended law school prep courses.

electiveGroups.name: Law School Prep Electives
electiveGroups.description: Upper-level courses in political science, philosophy, economics, or criminal justice.
